label: Public measured off-centre driver data used for the golfphys gear-effect/bulge validation. Every row is transcribed from the cited page; 'read' says how: fetched_text = page text read in full, fetched_image = numbers read off a table image downloaded from the page, snippet = search-result excerpt only (not opened). Nothing here is Mason/Instagram data.

hotstix_2009.what: Hot Stix robot, one 460 cc 9.5 deg driver (unnamed), 100 mph clubhead speed, tee height varied so impact moves up/down the face. Vertical offset only, centre horizontally.
hotstix_2009.origin: Golf Magazine Feb 2009 (not seen); numbers via Tutelman (launch, spin, distance) and Keiser Univ. College of Golf (spin, distance)
hotstix_2009.caveats: Distance is presumably total (Tutelman's assumption). H is tee-height-derived offset from face centre, +/- accuracy not stated. Ball speed, AoA, dynamic loft not published. Robot data, one head.

mygolfspy_2016_vertical.what: MyGolfSpy Most Wanted Driver test 2016: ~5700 shots, 20 golfers x 25 drivers, Foresight GC2 + HMT (HMT gives impact location). Bins: centre = within +/-4.5 mm of face centre; high / low = beyond. Mean offsets of the high/low bins are NOT published.
mygolfspy_2016_vertical.caveats: Player-hit shots: bins are confounded with swing speed, attack angle and tester. Reported 'dynamic loft' moves OPPOSITE to launch (high face: DL -1.9 deg, launch +1.25 deg), so it is not the impact-location loft TrackMan defines; do not use it as a model input without care. Amateurs (CHS 91-110 mph).

mygolfspy_2016_horizontal.what: Same 2016 dataset, heel/toe bins (centre +/-4.5 mm). Axis tilt: Foresight sign, negative = left-tilted axis (draw for a right-hander). Side angle + = right of target. Mean offsets of heel/toe bins NOT published.
mygolfspy_2016_horizontal.caveats: Same confounds as the vertical study. Toe hits are usually also high on the face and heel hits low (MyGolfSpy says so), so launch/spin deltas mix horizontal and vertical effects. Heel bin has lower CHS because the HMT/GC2 club speed is measured at the face centre and heel strikes are slower swings (or the tester moves); heel smash equals centre smash, toe smash is 1.8% lower.

golfdigest_robot_2026.what: Golf Digest / Golf Laboratories swing robot, 95 mph, square face/path, neutral AoA, Titleist Pro V1; March 2026 article: six mishit spots 0.75 in toe/heel x (low, middle, high); June 2026 article: 47 drivers x 9 zones x 6 shots (offsets not stated in that article). Carry yards. Field-average numbers only (per-head charts are images, not read).
golfdigest_robot_2026.caveats: 47 modern heads with very different MOI/CG (draw-bias, low-spin). Toe 'about 5 yd' is stated for the top-10 toe performers only, not the field. Article says toe gives 'right-tilting sidespin' which contradicts MyGolfSpy/Tutelman (draw for a right-hander); treated as an editorial slip, not used.

trackman_blog_2017.what: TrackMan definition note: for standard drivers a 10 mm impact toward the toe makes face angle ~2 deg more open at the impact location than at face centre; 10 mm low makes dynamic loft ~2 deg lower.
trackman_blog_2017.caveats: Stated as approximate, 'standard drivers'; not a measured data set.

trackman_fundamentals.what: TrackMan '10 fundamentals' pdf: 92 mph club speed off-centre -> 129 mph ball, 196 yd carry; 88 mph centre -> 132 mph ball, 204 yd.

upshaw_via_tutelman.what: Dana Upshaw launch-monitor data as quoted by Tutelman: ~3300 rpm spin difference for a 1.5 in height difference at ~140 mph ball speed.

not_numeric_or_not_retrieved.RA_USGA_R22_07: https://www.usga.org/content/dam/usga/pdf/Equipment/R22-07%20The%20effect%20of%20impact%20position%20on%20driving%20distance.pdf - mechanical golfer, 115 mph, vertical offsets only; fetched via WebFetch text but ball speed/spin/launch/carry are in figures (no table); the only numbers in text: centre 167 mph / 10.5 deg / ~3000 rpm, max ball speed ~2 mm above geometric centre. The PDF itself returned Access Denied to curl, so the figures could not be digitised. Not used.
not_numeric_or_not_retrieved.tutelman_horizontal_table: Tutelman appendix 'App 2' horizontal gear-effect table is MODEL output (TrajectoWare + his equation), not measurements; golfphys's 16.4 coefficient comes from that model, so it is circular and excluded.
not_numeric_or_not_retrieved.Penner_2001_AJP: model paper (convex face angle effect vs gear effect); abstract via search only; no measurements. For a 2 cm offset the model gives optimum radius 21.5 cm, no-sidespin threshold 14.1 cm (snippet). Not used as data.
not_numeric_or_not_retrieved.Cross_2021_EJP: Experimental study of the gear effect (ball-on-pendulum style, tangential restitution of two ball types); abstract via search only; no driver launch-monitor numbers retrieved.
not_numeric_or_not_retrieved.Cochran_Stobbs_1968: book; not accessible; only through Tutelman secondary descriptions.
